scope: Read-only complete static inspection of exact three operational helpers and current config; AST syntax parsing only. No top-level helper, clone, network, Git mutation or cleanup executed.

assessments.result: New unique /private/tmp clone and receipt/archive/log paths refuse existing or symlink destinations; source checkout only read. Only remote main is cloned, tags explicitly fetched. Source tree equality, clean preflight HEAD and live trusted base are required; archive member checks and data filter constrain extraction. New synthetic commit is built within the clone.

Historical review-base tag exact annotated object and peeled commit are locally/remotely verified; all saved source revisions are checked as available commit objects by coverage. Three topic-object absence checks surround clone construction and gates. The historical tag name is intentional provenance, not stale cohort labeling.

Postmerge requires supplied actual main commit, exact reviewed tree and exactly one parent equal trusted base. Cleanup independently requires same actual merged PR head/tree/base/sole-parent and live origin/main before deletion.

Both modes run locked offline sync, nonempty strict record validation, canonical history against trusted base, full native review-check and exact-current scientific coverage; postmerge additionally runs just check. Final clean tracked/unignored state and tree equality are checked. Preflight does not claim to rerun just check.

Filesystem enumeration includes hidden/ignored content and follows links with cycle prevention; positive completed scientific reviews must match canonical ID, target path, reviewed-target scope and actual owner SHA. It supplements, not replaces, canonical semantic validation. Availability checks cover every distinct review source revision.

Only fixed round83 topic branch is eligible; actual MERGED state/exact head and clean current owned worktree are mandatory. Remote deletion uses exact-head force-with-lease, then confirms absence. Local deletion occurs after detach to actual merge and exact old ref match. Issues must have configured states. No original-main checkout mutation or directory removal.

limitations: Current helper-config snapshot is intentionally provisional: counts contains record_count=398 only. Forecast histories457/reviews474/bases84 are not verified by this static review. Before runtime acceptance, final reconciled config must include the full expected counts/covered_records; downstream final package audit must rebind it.
The coverage helper compares the keys actually provided in config; it is not an independent source for intended census. Its result remains dependent on a complete, reviewed final config.
No runtime success is asserted. Required terminal receipts, source/commit/tree bindings, complete native review validation and actual hosted state remain future acceptance gates.
Cleanup performs authorized topic-ref deletion only when run by coordinator; this audit did not execute it.
